waypoints.notes: GPS 13 - the run-in. Autonomy is engaged here, so NJORD 8.1's timer starts here. 8.0 m at 185 to the alongside berth.
GPS 14 - the FIRST docking and it is the PARALLEL one (2026-08-13). 2.7 m from the old handout's 17, which is where park_probe_deg comes from - CONFIRM ON THE WATER.
GPS 15 - first ring leg, 27.9 m at 291 out of the berth, and the longest on the course. Needs a live mark source (set_mark_source) or it is blind transit.
GPS 16 - second ring leg, 25.2 m at 179. Moved 12 m on 2026-08-13. At 179 the old venue buoyage rule inverts red and green: see buoyage 'route'.
GPS 17 - third ring leg, 16.6 m at 141, and this one inverts under the venue rule too. 1.7 m from the old handout's 13.
GPS 18 - the SECOND docking, BOW-IN, and the end. 16.4 m at 020 in. park_no_exit: the task ends inside this berth. 3.0 m from the old handout's 14, hence the probe bearing.
